text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Speak.
What is our next training?
choice_data_list: And that's the end of training!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *phew*~...
I'm gonna get out and eat some ice cream.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Consider it an honor.
I have chosen you as my training partner.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
“......Huh!?
Wait, what's that supposed to mean?! That's way too pushy!”

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
This is a royal decree.
I am not asking for your approval.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
You are fortunate.
For you are about to catch a glimpse of the King.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Eeeh...? I'm the one who's supposed to be thanking you?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
............
What are you dazing off for, you fool?
choice_data_list: Can I ask something of you too?
May I ask a favor of you as well?
I don't think doing any more is a good idea...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
There is no reason to hesitate.
...Entertain me, Jordan.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I don't get it at all... Are we seriously doing this?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Orfevre continued her
independent training until the sun went down.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
You have dared object to the King.
...Speak your mind, then.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Doesn't she look super mad? Everything okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Afterward, citing the risk of overtraining,
I spent a long time persuading Orfevre..."
